caption: The image is a detailed drawing of a rectangular wooden table with rounded edges on the tabletop, depicted against a plain beige background. The table is predominantly reddish-brown, with a polished wood grain pattern visible throughout the structure. The apron below the tabletop features a central decorative element, colored gold with a leaf motif. Supporting the tabletop are two turned and carved columns, each with a repeating diamond pattern, also in a reddish-brown tone. The table includes a lower shelf, rectangular with concave sides, connecting the columns. The legs of the table consist of four curved supports that expand outward, each ending in a small animal paw-shaped foot with a gold finish. These feet are fitted with small black wheels or casters. The composition is centered, showing the entire table with all its parts distinctly visible.
title: Card Table
